
'''Yamada Shrine''' (山田神社) refers to various Shinto shrines located across Japan.

* '''Kanagawa Prefecture'''
** Yamada Shrine (Yokohama City) - Located in Minamiyamada Town, Tsuzuki Ward, Yokohama City. A shrine designated for offerings and former village shrine.

* '''Osaka Prefecture'''
** Yamada Shrine (Hirataka) - Located in Yamanoue, Hirakata City. A former village shrine.
** Yamada Shrine - Located in Taguchi, Hirakata City. A former village shrine.

* '''Yamaguchi Prefecture'''
** Yamada Shrine (Yamaguchi City) - Located in Ato Jifuku Kami, Yamaguchi City.
** '''Yamada Shrine (Suō Province)''' - A shrine listed in the historical records of Suō Province.
*** Yamada Shrine (Suō-Ōshima Town) - Located in Sotoiri, Suō-Ōshima Town, Ōshima District, Yamaguchi Prefecture. A candidate for the above shrine.
*** Yamada Shrine (Shikano Town) - Previously located in Shikano Town, now part of Shunan City, Yamaguchi Prefecture. Referred to as Nisho Yamada Shrine.

* '''Kagawa Prefecture'''
** Yamada Shrine (Kanonji City) - Located in Kuda Town, Kanonji City. A former village shrine and a Shikinaisha.
